Match the requested metric to its biological input object and observation unit.

  sequences are aligned.

/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
import os, json
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance
key=open(os.environ['GALAXY_API_KEY_FILE']).read().strip()
gi=GalaxyInstance(url=os.environ.get('GALAXY_URL','https://usegalaxy.org'),key=key)
tid='toolshed.g2.bx.psu.edu/repos/goeckslab/phykit_metrics/phykit_metrics/0.2.0+galaxy0'
t=gi.tools.show_tool(tid, io_details=True)
# recursively summarize conditionals/selects names and values
def walk(inputs, path=''):
    for inp in inputs or []:
        typ=inp.get('type'); name=inp.get('name')
        p=f'{path}/{name}' if path else name
        if typ=='conditional':
            tp=inp.get('test_param',{})
            print('CONDITIONAL', p, 'test', tp.get('name'), 'options', tp.get('options'))
            for case in inp.get('cases',[]):
                print(' CASE', p, case.get('value'))
                walk(case.get('inputs'), p+'='+case.get('value',''))
        elif typ=='repeat':
            print('REPEAT', p)
            walk(inp.get('inputs'), p+'[]')
        elif typ=='section':
            print('SECTION', p)
            walk(inp.get('inputs'), p)
        else:
            print('PARAM', p, typ, 'label=', inp.get('label'), 'value=', inp.get('value'), 'ext=', inp.get('extensions'), 'options=', inp.get('options') if typ=='select' else None)
walk(t.get('inputs'))
PY"
